The '''DX-2 Dominator Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] the droid, along with [[TZ-3 Dominator Droid]] and [[C2-N Dominator Droid]] was used to defend the approach to the [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]] in the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], but was destroyed during the assault by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
DX-2 Dominator Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission on Corellia. The droid appears in one of three possible approach routes and, depending on the player's choices, can be destroyed by the [[Fifty-third Armored Platoon]], the [[Eighty-first Infantry]] or by [[Havoc Squad]].
